description: Source code for Bluetooth Mesh SAR (Segmentation and Reassembly) configuration CLI commands, including functions for getting and setting transmitter and receiver parameters, and defining CLI command sets.

methods.name: cmd_tx_get
methods.description: Handles 'tx-get' CLI command to retrieve SAR transmitter parameters.

methods.name: cmd_tx_set
methods.description: Handles 'tx-set' CLI command to set SAR transmitter parameters.

methods.name: cmd_rx_get
methods.description: Handles 'rx-get' CLI command to retrieve SAR receiver parameters.

methods.name: cmd_rx_set
methods.description: Handles 'rx-set' CLI command to set SAR receiver parameters.
